title: Scenario 5: Encoded PowerShell Execution
description: APT29 frequently uses encoded PowerShell commands to evade detection. These commands are Base64-encoded to hide malicious intentions.
hunt_for: PowerShell execution with -EncodedCommand or -enc flags. Also look for FromBase64String in command lines.
kibana_query: EventID:1 AND (CommandLine:*-enc* OR CommandLine:*-encodedcommand* OR CommandLine:*frombase64*)
detection_tips: Search for Sysmon Event ID 1 (Process Creation)
Look for powershell.exe in the Image field
Decode Base64 strings to analyze actual commands
key_indicators: Long Base64 strings in command line
